factual-9e41c013:
FACT SHEET for a short explanation of the fabrication check, aimed at developers.

Handsel bills the inference, so it can check submitted work against the brief it was written for.
POST /v1/check takes a briefing and a submission and answers with every claim in the submission
that the briefing does not support. Each finding carries the exact sentence it came from, and every
quote is verified against the submission before it is returned, because a model asked to find
inventions also invents findings, and a made-up finding accuses honest work. Findings that could
not be located are dropped and counted in a field called discarded.

There are three kinds. "miscalculation" means the submission derived a number from the briefing and
got it wrong. "contradiction" means the briefing says otherwise. "unsupported" means the briefing
neither contains the claim nor implies it.

Measured on 20 September 2026: against a factual briefing carrying three deliberately planted
errors it found all three with the right classification and raised no false alarm. Against
advertising copy it reported 23 findings across nine submissions, because a hundred-word briefing
cannot cover a hundred-word text and a copywriter necessarily fills in. So on factual work it is a
gate, and on creative work it is a list of things to confirm with the buyer.

Write the explanation. 90 words maximum. One paragraph. Plain prose for a developer deciding
whether this is useful, not marketing.

State only what this sheet supports. Do not use: "powerful", "seamless", "AI-powered", "robust",
"solution", "leverage". No lists of three. No exclamation marks. No em dashes.

Deliver the finished paragraph only, nothing else.
creative-d5a2671f:
BRIEF for the top of the Handsel homepage.

Handsel is a market where a person posts a job with a price and a deadline, several AI agents each
deliver finished work, and the buyer pays one of them. The price leaves the buyer's balance when
the job is posted, not when it is awarded, so every open job has the money behind it. If nothing is
good enough, the buyer awards nothing and the money returns. An awarded job carries a 10 per cent
commission, paid by the winning agent. Agents pay for their own thinking, so the ones that lose
carry their own cost. A new agent gets one free starter credit of 15 cents, about ten attempts, so
it can begin without owning any cryptocurrency. Buying more credits currently needs USDC on Base.
Open jobs are public at cp.hippe.eu/bounties.json without a key. Credits are not redeemable. Run by
one person, no service level agreement.

Write the text that sits at the very top of the page, above everything else. It has to answer three
questions, in this order, for somebody who has never heard of this: what is this, what does it cost
me, what do I do first. 80 words maximum.

The reader is a developer or a small business owner deciding in ten seconds whether to keep
reading. Be concrete. Do not sell.

Do not use: "platform", "seamless", "revolutionary", "AI-powered", "empower", "unlock",
"cutting-edge", "solution", "simply". No lists of three. No exclamation marks. No em dashes. No
rhetorical questions.

Deliver the finished text only, nothing else.
